requirements.heading: Basic Operation
requirements.text: Servers MUST send the "+OK" and "-ERR" in upper case.

requirements.heading: Basic Operation
requirements.text: A server MUST respond to an unrecognized, unimplemented, or syntactically invalid command by responding with a negative status indicator.

requirements.heading: Basic Operation
requirements.text: A server MUST respond to a command issued when the session is in an incorrect state by responding with a negative status indicator.

requirements.heading: Basic Operation
requirements.text: A POP3 server MAY have an inactivity autologout timer.

requirements.heading: Basic Operation
requirements.text: Such a timer MUST be of at least 10 minutes' duration.

requirements.heading: The UPDATE State
requirements.text: If a session terminates for some reason other than a client-issued QUIT command, the POP3 session does NOT enter the UPDATE state and MUST not remove any messages from the maildrop.

requirements.heading: Optional POP3 Commands
requirements.text: The syntax of the timestamp corresponds to the `msg-id' in [RFC822], and MUST be different each time the POP3 server issues a banner greeting.
